title: Today is my birthday
simplified_paragraphs: 今天是我的生日。我送给自己的礼物是一双鞋，那双鞋有点儿贵，但是我喜欢很久了。朋友们送给我一束花、一瓶香水、一个大蛋糕，这些东西我都很喜欢。我的爸爸妈妈给我发了一个红包，里面有八百块钱。我想用这些钱请朋友们吃饭，然后去唱歌。这就是我的生日。
traditional_paragraphs: 今天是我的生日。我送給自己的禮物是一雙鞋，那雙鞋有點兒貴，但是我喜歡很久了。朋友們送給我一束花、一瓶香水、一個大蛋糕，這些東西我都很喜歡。我的爸爸媽媽給我發了一個紅包，裡面有八百塊錢。我想用這些錢請朋友們吃飯，然後去唱歌。這就是我的生日。
pinyin_paragraphs: jīn tiān shì wǒ de shēng rì。 wǒ sòng gěi zì jǐ de lǐ wù shì yī shuāng xié， nà shuāng xié yǒu diǎn r guì， dàn shì wǒ xǐ huan hěn jiǔ le。 péng you men sòng gěi wǒ yī shù huā、 yī píng xiāng shuǐ、 yī gè dà dàn gāo， zhè xiē dōng xi wǒ dōu hěn xǐ huan。 wǒ de bà ba mā ma gěi wǒ fā le yī gè hóng bāo， lǐ miàn yǒu bā bǎi kuài qián。 wǒ xiǎng yòng zhè xiē qián qǐng péng you men chī fàn， rán hòu qù chàng gē。 zhè jiù shì wǒ de shēng rì。
english_paragraphs: Today is my birthday. The gift I gave myself was a pair of shoes. Those shoes were a bit expensive, but I have liked them for a long time. My friends gave me a bouquet of flowers, a bottle of perfume, and a big cake, which I loved very much. My parents sent me a red envelope with eight hundred yuan in it. I want to use the money to treat my friends to dinner and then go singing. This is my birthday.
english_full: Today is my birthday. The gift I gave myself was a pair of shoes. Those shoes were a bit expensive, but I have liked them for a long time. My friends gave me a bouquet of flowers, a bottle of perfume, and a big cake, which I loved very much. My parents sent me a red envelope with eight hundred yuan in it. I want to use the money to treat my friends to dinner and then go singing. This is my birthday.
